intro.title: text-align and vertical-align
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple webpage that demonstrates how to align text horizontally and vertically within elements. You will learn the core CSS properties text-align and vertical-align to control text positioning. The main technologies involved are HTML for structure and CSS for styling, focusing on these alignment properties. This beginner-friendly lesson will help you understand how to center, left-align, right-align, and vertically adjust text in your web projects.
intro.usecase: The text-align and vertical-align properties are essential for creating clean, readable, and professional layouts across many real-world interfaces. For instance, developers use text-align to center headings in a dashboard's header panel, right-align prices in an e-commerce product list, or justify paragraphs in an article modal. Vertical-align is crucial for aligning icons with text in navigation menus, ensuring form labels and input fields sit neatly on the same baseline, or positioning status indicators within table cells in an admin panel. Mastering these properties allows you to precisely control text and inline element positioning, a fundamental skill for building polished user interfaces that meet design specifications.
